I-276 Doc Zapnozzle at the Shipwreck Shore arrival point. Ender of 14239 "Don't Go Into the Light!", the revive that opens the Lost Isles. Retail script-summons him (spell 69018, effect 28 SUMMON misc 36608), so neither the Neltharion dump nor TDB 4.3.4 has a spawn row and the spawn-driven zone sweep never saw him -- he was absent from creature_template entirely. Position is Justin's in-game .gps reading, z = FloorZ 0.26209486 (GroundZ there is -15.99, i.e. the heightmap seabed under the vmap shore -- never place off GroundZ here).
